name: tanji-native-hg
description: 探记 HG —— 面向探店创作者的独立行程、交付与收款 App

scripts.sync: npm run build:plugins && npm run build:app && cap sync ios
scripts.build:ios: npm run sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.build:ios:device: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphoneos -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:generate && xcodebuild -project ios/TanjiNative/TanjiNative.xcodeproj -scheme TanjiNative -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build OTHER_SWIFT_FLAGS='$(inherited) -Xfrontend -disable-sandbox'
scripts.ios:test: npm run ios:generate && xcodebuild test -project ios/TanjiNative/TanjiNative.xcodeproj -scheme TanjiNative -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -skip-testing:TanjiNativeUITests/TanjiLayoutProbe OTHER_SWIFT_FLAGS='$(inherited) -Xfrontend -disable-sandbox'
scripts.ios:test:layout: npm run ios:generate && xcodebuild test -project ios/TanjiNative/TanjiNative.xcodeproj -scheme TanjiNative -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -only-testing:TanjiNativeUITests/TanjiLayoutProbe OTHER_SWIFT_FLAGS='$(inherited) -Xfrontend -disable-sandbox'
